Prepare Object for Calculations in deriv2 Methods

Source: R/utils.R
prep_deriv2_object.Rd

Setting up the object (a named list) used by the deriv2 methods for calculating score and hessian.

Usage

prep_deriv2_object(d, n, which, order)

Arguments

d

object of class distribution.

n

number of observations (length of score/Hessian vectors).

which

NULL or character vector. If NULL all available parameters will returned. If character, the user-specified parameters are returned.

order

defines the order of derivatives to be calculated and returned. 1 (scores), 2 (Hessian), or 1:2 (both).

Value

Named list with three elements. $which is a named list of length 2 containing a named character vector with the derivatives to be calculated for both score and Hessian, or NULL if not required.

Similarely, $score and $hessian are NULL if no first or second derivative is requested by the user. Else these two elements contain a named list with empty numeric vectors of length n later on filled by the corresponding C function.
